title: Found Parcels under Delivery Claims: Order Age, Regular-Price Lines and the Charge Base
content:
Recovery schedule for Delivery Claims: the charge base of a found-parcel charge follows the age of the order and the price the kept line sold at.

**Rule.** The charge base depends on the age of the order and the price the line sold at: for a line sold at regular price on an order placed more than 60 calendar days before today, the charge base is the line's booked unit price times the units compensated on that line, less 30% of it, with no tax share; for a regular-price line on an order placed more than 30 and at most 60 calendar days before today, the charge base is the merchandise compensation for the line less 15% of it; in every other case the charge base is the merchandise compensation for the line.

## Terms

- Age of the order: calendar days from the order's placed date to today.
- Regular price: the booking line of the kept line shows the price type regular.
- Booked unit price: the unit price on that booking line.
- Units compensated on that line: the units of the claim's merchandise refund entries for that line.
- Merchandise compensation for the line: the claim's merchandise refund entries on that line, tax share included.

| Line price type | Order age | Charge base |
|---|---|---|
| regular | more than 60 days | booked unit price times units compensated, less 30% of it, no tax share |
| regular | more than 30, at most 60 days | merchandise compensation for the line, less 15% of it |
| regular | 30 days or less | merchandise compensation for the line |
| any other price type | any age | merchandise compensation for the line |

## Edges

30 days: compensation as booked. 31 days: less 15%. 60 days: less 15%. 61 days: unit price basis less 30%.

## Worked figures (hypothetical line: unit price 50.00 USD, 2 units compensated, merchandise compensation 108.00 USD including tax share)

| Order age and price type | Charge base |
|---|---|
| 75 days, regular | 50.00 times 2, that is 100.00, less 30% — 70.00 USD |
| 45 days, regular | 108.00 less 15% — 91.80 USD |
| 20 days, regular | 108.00 USD |
| 75 days, a price type other than regular | 108.00 USD |
